title: Watch a type environment grow
description: You can inspect inferred types in a straight-line sequence of bindings.

steps.description: Num and Bool infer to Int and Bool. A variable reads its type from tenv, the dictionary of known bindings.
Arithmetic requires two Int operands. The other binary path requires matching operand types and returns Bool.
check_sequence infers each expression before extending the dictionary. A failure prints the current dictionary and returns.

steps.question: Does a rejected binding enter the type dictionary?
steps.answer: No. The error path returns before the dictionary assignment.

steps.description: The first sequence records a and b as Int and c as Bool. The second reports the supplied c + 1 error while preserving those three earlier bindings.
